robinetterie-petrole-forgee-moulee.body: Forged and cast valves for hydrocarbons, gas and demanding industrial processes: gate, globe and bellows valves, needle valves, strainers and check valves. Ranges sized to DIN, EN, ANSI and API, with material traceability (3.1 certificates on request) and technical support at SDMI counter.

tuyauteries.body: Steel tubes for fluid networks: carbon steel API 5L, ASTM A106, A53 Gr.B and A333 Gr.6, welded and seamless pipe, ASTM A312 stainless and SCH40 3PE coated tubes. DN6 to DN1000 depending on the range, with 3.1 material certificates on request.

accessoires.body: Flanges, fittings and accessories for fluid networks: EN 1092 and ASME flanges, threaded, welded and mechanical fittings, expansion joints and water-network equipment. Solutions for water, oil, gas and industrial utilities.

brides.body: EN 1092 carbon steel flanges and forged hubs for piping joints: plate, blank, weld-neck, slip-on and threaded, from PN10 to PN40.

raccords-et-fittings.body: EN 10242 malleable iron threaded fittings: elbows, tees, crosses, sockets, nipples, plugs and flat-seat unions. BSPT thread, NPT on request, hot-dip galvanized or black finish. Working pressure up to 34.5 bar depending on size. Aluminium, stainless, brass and polypropylene camlock couplings, with EPDM, NBR and FKM gaskets.

vannes.body: Gate and knife gate valves for isolation on water, process and heavy industry networks: monobloc, flanged, forged, resilient seated and unidirectional or bidirectional S-gate models.

robinets-soupape-pointeau.body: Globe valves, needle valves and fire protection equipment (dry risers, column bases) for technical networks, sprinklers and building & industrial installations.

robinets-tournant-spherique-acier-inox.body: Steel and stainless ball valves: monobloc, two- and three-piece, multi-port, wafer and flanged designs for aggressive fluids, steam and pressurized process.

vannes-sphere-laiton-fonte-pvc.body: Brass, cast iron and PVC ball valves for building services, water networks, light industry and utilities: lockable models, 3-way, tapping and threaded or flanged connections.

etancheite-statique.body: Static sealing gaskets and elements for flanges and assemblies: elastomer fiber, graphite, metallic gaskets, PTFE, mica, elastomers, O-rings, quad-lobe seals, sleeves and packings. Quotation and cut-to-drawing at the SDMI counter in Dakar.

circuit-eau-petrole-gaz.metaTitle: Water, oil & gas — industrial valves | SDMI Dakar
circuit-eau-petrole-gaz.metaDescription: Valves, flanges and piping for water, hydrocarbon and gas networks in Senegal: Dakar stock, 3.1 certificates, DN/PN quotes within 24 h.
circuit-eau-petrole-gaz.title: Critical fluids for energy and water–oil–gas networks
circuit-eau-petrole-gaz.lead: SDMI supplies water distribution networks, fuel depots, gas lines and power assets across Senegal with valves sized for pressure, corrosion and uptime. From our Bopp counter to major projects, we secure your fluid loops with traceable references and responsive engineering support.
circuit-eau-petrole-gaz.standards: API 6D / 600, ANSI B16.34, EN 1092 & EN 10204 type 3.1 — PN10 to PN100, Class 150 to 600.
challenges: Aggressive fluids, H₂S and corrosion in oil & gas service.
Pressure swings on transmission mains, boosting and water pumping stations.
Traceability requirements for owner dossiers, utilities and QHSE audits.
Flange, DN and material compatibility between legacy networks and extensions.
Tight windows for planned shutdowns, O&M and like-for-like replacement.
applications: Potable water transmission, boosting and treatment plants.
Fuel depots, loading terminals, onshore pipelines and process manifolds.
Gas networks, thermal power, cogeneration and regulation skids.
Transfer lines, bypass, vent/drain and isolation on industrial assets.
EPC projects, industrial maintenance and pressurized asset renewal.
supplyItems: Valves, cocks, check valves and strainers matched to fluid, DN/PN and temperature.
Flanges, fittings, gaskets and piping accessories for complete loops.
Technical alternatives and counter stock to reduce downtime.
EN 10204 3.1 material certificates and documentation for tenders.
Structured quotes from BOQs, isometrics or project BOMs.

industrie-agro-alimentaire.metaTitle: Food industry — stainless process valves | SDMI Dakar
industrie-agro-alimentaire.metaDescription: Stainless valves, cocks and piping for food processing in Senegal: hygiene, CIP, food-contact compliance, Dakar stock.
industrie-agro-alimentaire.title: Hygiene, stainless and process for food industry
industrie-agro-alimentaire.lead: SDMI supports sugar plants, breweries, dairies and processing units across Senegal with valves built for hygiene, CIP/SIP cleaning and corrosion resistance. Polished stainless, reliable sealing and material traceability — we size your food and process loops for production uptime and quality audits.
industrie-agro-alimentaire.standards: AISI 304L / 316L stainless, CE 1935/2004 (food contact), FDA good practices — sanitary finishes and CIP-compatible seals.
challenges: Food contact, migration limits and regulatory compliance (EU / internal audits).
Aggressive CIP/SIP cycles: thermal shock, acids/bases and seal wear.
Cross-contamination risk — sterile zones, isolation and dead legs to control.
Corrosion from sugary products, wort and concentrated cleaning solutions.
Planned maintenance on continuous lines: fast like-for-like replacement.
applications: Transfer, dosing and isolation on sugar factories and refineries.
Breweries, soft drinks and juices — cold/hot loops and pasteurization.
Dairy, cheese and liquid milk — hygiene and polished stainless.
Oil mills, flour mills and grain processing — process valves and fittings.
Filtration skids, sampling bypass and drain on packaging units.
supplyItems: Stainless valves, butterfly/ball valves and cocks for food fluids.
Brass, coated cast iron or PVC valves for utilities and non-direct food lines.
Control cocks (globe, needle) for sampling and drain lines.
Seal and finish selection compatible with your CIP chemistry.
Quotes from loop drawings, BOMs and urgent O&M requirements.

familySummaries.robinets-tournant-spherique-acier-inox: Stainless ball valves for sanitary isolation, frequent cycling and CIP food lines.

tuyauterie-materiels-incendie.metaTitle: Fire protection & safety valves | SDMI Dakar
tuyauterie-materiels-incendie.metaDescription: Hydrants, valves, manifolds and fire piping in Senegal: sprinklers, hose reels, industrial sites, Dakar stock and commissioning support.
tuyauterie-materiels-incendie.title: Fire protection and safety valves
tuyauterie-materiels-incendie.lead: SDMI supplies valves and piping that secure fire networks on industrial sites, depots and commercial buildings across Senegal. Sprinklers, hose reel stations, alarm valves and fill accessories — we size your loops for available pressure, layout schemes and requirements from authorities and insurers.
tuyauterie-materiels-incendie.standards: NFPA / APSAD-type schemes, FM & UL listings on dedicated references — fire-listed valves, PN ratings for fire water networks.
challenges: Available pressure and flow on fire water mains or dedicated booster sets.
Valve and piping coordination with detection, alarms and control panels.
Corrosive environments (coastal air, outdoor) and long-term reliability.
Commissioning dossiers, hydro tests and regulatory acceptance.
Fast turnaround for extensions, zoning changes or post-incident replacement.
applications: Automatic sprinkler systems — warehouses, industry and retail.
Fire hose reels (RIA), dry/wet risers and hydrant outlets.
Deluge posts, ATEX zones and critical equipment protection.
Fuel depots, logistics terminals and high-risk industrial sites.
Site extensions, O&M and return to service after works or safety audits.
supplyItems: Valves, cocks and check valves for fire loops, bypass and testing.
Piping, flanges, fittings and accessories for manifolds and branches.
Gate, knife gate or butterfly valves for large bore and zone isolation.
Forged/cast valves for hard points, manifolds and high-pressure service.
Quotes from sprinkler layouts, hydraulic notes and engineer BOMs.

industrie-miniere.metaDescription: Valves, piping and fittings for mines, quarries and mineral processing in Senegal: abrasion, slurry, pressure and stock in Dakar.
industrie-miniere.title: The mining industry
industrie-miniere.lead: Valves, piping and fittings for mines, quarries and mineral processing: abrasion, slurry and pressure, with stock in Dakar. SDMI supplies slurry, process-water and compressed-air circuits with references sized for wear and production uptime.
industrie-miniere.standards: API 600 / 6D, EN 1092, ASTM A106 / API 5L — abrasion-resistant linings, cast irons and steels for severe service.
challenges: Abrasion from slurry, sand and ore on valves, elbows and transfer lines.
Dense slurry, clogging and frequent operation on isolation and control.
Pressure, shock and corrosion on process water, air and reagents.
Production uptime on crushing, grinding, flotation and thickening.
Short lead times for planned shutdowns and like-for-like replacement.
applications: Mines and quarries: slurry transfer, hydrocyclones and ponds.
Mineral processing: grinding, flotation, filtration and thickeners.
Phosphates, cement plants and raw-material preparation units.
Process-water, compressed-air and reagent networks.
Maintenance, line extensions and replacement of worn equipment.
supplyItems: Knife gate, gate and butterfly valves for isolation in abrasive service.
Carbon steel tubes, flanges and fittings for slurry and process-water lines.
Threaded fittings and couplings for branches, instrumentation and utilities.
Selection by fluid, DN/PN, temperature and the nature of the abrasive.
Quotes from drawings, BOMs and replacement lists, with stock in Dakar.
